FSSAI finds Nestle dairy whitener unsafe, orders halt to sales

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has declared a sample of Nestle's low-fat dairy whitener, collected at Hotel Lalit, as "unsafe." Following this finding, FSSAI has ordered an immediate halt to the sales of the product.
